2607.16175.title: Evaluating Open-Weight LLMs for Generating Structured Threat Information for Autonomous Vehicle Vulnerabilities
2607.16175.paper_summary: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) rely on interconnected software and hardware components, including sensors, Electronic Control Units, in-vehicle infotainment systems, and telematics units, where vulnerabilities can compromise assets, users, and vehicle operations. These vulnerabilities are commonly documented as plain text in the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) database; however, security practitioners require structured information about affected assets, types of weaknesses, and attack behaviors to effectively mitigate the risks from these vulnerabilities. To this end, we evaluate open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) for generating Structured Threat Information Expression (STIX), a well-known structured format for representing threat information, for CAV-related CVEs. We construct a dataset called CAV-STIXGen that maps CAV vulnerability descriptions to STIX domain objects (SDO), STIX relationship objects (SRO), Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE), and MITRE ATT&CK techniques mappings. Using this dataset, we evaluated 11 open-weight LLMs (4B to 120B parameters) across various prompting strategies and temperatures. Single-model configurations achieve F1 scores of 0.94 for SDO, 0.63 for SRO, and 0.99 for CWE mapping, while complete MITRE ATT&CK mapping remains challenging. In a multi-agent setup, Gemma-4-31B and Codestral-22B achieve F1 scores of 0.91 for SDOs and 0.43 for SROs, respectively. Lastly, we analyze CWE and MITRE ATT&CK co-occurrences to identify recurring threat patterns in the CAV domain, demonstrating how AI-assisted vulnerability-to-STIX translation can automate threat intelligence and prioritize defense in transportation security.
2607.16175.paper_summary_zh: 連接和自主車輛（CAVs）依賴於互聯的軟體和硬體組件，包括傳感器、電子控制單元、車載資訊娛樂系統和遠端信息單元，其中的漏洞可能會危及資產、用戶和車輛操作。這些漏洞通常以純文本形式記錄在通用漏洞和曝光（CVE）數據庫中；然而，安全專業人士需要有關受影響資產、弱點類型和攻擊行為的結構化信息，以有效減輕這些漏洞帶來的風險。為此，我們評估了開放權重的大型語言模型（LLMs），用於生成結構化威脅信息表達（STIX），這是一種用於表示威脅信息的知名結構化格式，針對與CAV相關的CVE。我們構建了一個名為CAV-STIXGen的數據集，將CAV漏洞描述映射到STIX領域對象（SDO）、STIX關係對象（SRO）、通用弱點枚舉（CWE）和MITRE ATT&CK技術映射。利用這個數據集，我們評估了11個開放權重的LLM（4B到120B參數），涵蓋各種提示策略和溫度。單模型配置在SDO上達到0.94的F1分數，在SRO上達到0.63，在CWE映射上達到0.99，而完整的MITRE ATT&CK映射仍然具有挑戰性。在多代理設置中，Gemma-4-31B和Codestral-22B分別在SDO上達到0.91的F1分數和在SRO上達到0.43的F1分數。最後，我們分析CWE和MITRE ATT&CK的共現，以識別CAV領域中反覆出現的威脅模式，展示了如何利用AI輔助的漏洞到STIX翻譯來自動化威脅情報並優先考慮交通安全中的防禦。
